paragraphs: Welcome to the open-source headquarters of RedStonePosting, a retro, video-game-styled social hub for sharing your thoughts.
Yes, it is completely open source. Yes, you can click that fork button. But guess what? If you just copy this repository and click deploy, you will get a completely blank website.

Why? Because my private database settings and the secret background logic are safely locked away in Vercel. If you want your own working copy, you actually have to figure out the backend structure on your own. I am not giving away the secret sauce for free!
features: Super Fast Loading: No massive, heavy software packages that take minutes to load and slow down your phone or computer. Just plain, speedy website files.

Total Anonymity: Users pick a custom nickname and get a colorful avatar box with the first letter of their name inside. No private emails are ever collected, so hackers can't leak your private data and blame the…
The Reaction Counter: You can slap 🔥 Fire and ❤️ Heart buttons onto people's posts and watch the number scores count up instantly.
Custom Error Screen: It has a customized 404 page that lets people know the link they were looking for does not exist anymore.
